turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently do not ship internationally outside of the United States and select regions within Canada.

Here is how it works by region:

Outside the US and Canada
We do not offer shipping, so customs and duties do not apply.
Within Canada (eligible regions only)
We do ship select items to limited regions in Canada on a seasonal basis.
All Canadian prices are listed in CAD and already include all duties and taxes in the product price.
That means you should not receive a separate customs or duty bill on delivery; those costs are built into what you pay at checkout.
Within the US
We ship throughout the contiguous United States, with limited availability to Alaska and Hawaii.
Customs and duties do not apply for US deliveries.

If you tell me the country or region you’re in, I can clarify exactly what options are available to you.
